bullets.text: The Spurs and Lakers are both 11-2 atop the West, while the Celtics lead the East at 10-2 and all three are running hot.
The Bucks and Jazz are both 1-12 and the Kings are 1-11, leaving all three far behind the rest of the league and gone cold.
Records and play don't match: the Knicks are 6-6 despite a +73 point differential, while the Heat are 7-6 with a -15 differential.
